lines.intro: This is the Experiments tab of your forge. Four steps: a baseline, one change, the same questions again, then before and after.
lines.baseline: This knob shows only when something goes wrong, so we use the three error questions: a code written wrong, a closed cost centre, and a date in the past. Run 1 is the shipped toolbox: three of three right.
lines.pick: Pick: loose input schemas. Nothing is required, there are no format hints, and nothing is checked at the door.
lines.settings: Your settings list the change, on every tool.
lines.run: Run the three error questions again. Here it is sped up.
lines.result: Before and after. The same score, three of three.
lines.tiles: This time the loose run even used fewer tokens: the baseline happened to make one extra call. One run each cannot tell a knob from chance. Run it twice.
lines.table: The model wrote good arguments either way, so there was nothing for the door to stop.
lines.trace: Open the trace of question E3, the date in the past.
lines.trace2: The date went through to Ledgerline, and Ledgerline refused it. The tool turned the refusal into words and a next step: ask the user for a future date.
lines.next: Next: try another change, or set one by hand on the Anvil. After two or three knobs, go on to the Shield.
